shared_elements: human figure(s) with arms bent toward the body/front
anthropomorphic figure in frontal or profile view carved in relief
schematic rendering of arms and hands
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures with schematically rendered arms drawn in toward the torso, but A is a multi-figure narrative scene in low relief with figures in profile, offering stands, sign-like elements and a register of small symbols below, while B is a single free-standing pillar-like figure with an oversized head and hands meeting at the belly, with no accompanying scene or signs. The correspondence amounts only to 'a human figure with arms bent forward', which any tradition could produce independently; the compositional schemes are entirely different.
